@realm:     Mentalism
@name:      Sea Mastery
@category:  Training Package

# Format: <level> | <spell_name> | <area_effect> | <duration> | <range> | <type>
# A trailing '*' on the name marks a Concentration / continuing-effect spell.

 1 | Predict Winds | 1 mi R/lvl | - | self | I
 2 | Predict Precipitation | 1 mi R/lvl | - | self | I
 3 | Predict Storms | 1 mi R/lvl | - | self | I
 4 | Predict Weather I | 1 mi R/lvl | - | self | I
 5 | Clear Fog | 10’R/lvl | P | self | F
 6 | Call Fog | 10’R/lvl | 10min/lvl | 100’ | E
 7 | Waveshield | special | 10min/lvl | self | F
 8 | Predict Weather III | 3 mi R/lvl | - | self | I
 9 | Weathershield | special | 10min/lvl | self | F
10 | Command Current I | special | C | self | E
11 | Clear Fog True | 100’R/lvl | P | self | F
12 | Predict Weather V | 5 mi R/lvl | - | self | I
13 | Call Fog True | 100’R/lvl | 10min/lvl | 100’ | E
14 | Stormshield | special | 10min/lvl | self | F
15 | Command Winds | 1 mi R | 10min/lvl | self | E
16 | Predict Weather True | 5 mi R/lvl | - | self | I
17 | Command Waves | 1 mi R | 10min/lvl | self | E
19 | Command Weather | 1 mi R | 10min/lvl | self | E
20 | Command Storms | 1 mi R | varies | self | E
25 | Command Current V | special | C | self | E
30 | Command Weather True | 1 mi R/lvl | 10min/lvl | 1 mi/lvl | E
50 | Command Storms True | 1 mi R/lvl | varies | 1 mi/lvl | E

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes), direction
(within one point on the compass), and speed of winds (±5 mph) over the next
24 hour period in an area designated at time of casting.
@@ 2
Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes) and type of
precipitation over the next 24 hour period in an area designated at time of
casting.
@@ 3
Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes) and type of
storms over the next 24 hour period in an area designated at time of casting.
@@ 4
Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes), type, and
severity of weather over the next 24 hour period in an area designated at time
of casting.
@@ 5
All fog or mist in the area is dissipated. Magically created fog or mist may
receive an RR (GM’s discretion).
@@ 6
Caster causes fog to arise that obscures all vision in and through the area.
Normal vision inside the fog is limited to approximately 1’. All missile
attacks into or out of the fog are modified at -10 to -50 (GM discretion).
@@ 7
The area of effect for this spell is 1’ per level around the boat that the
caster is currently on. All incoming waves are reduced in size by up to 1’ per
level (of the caster). Wave action created as a result of magic may receive an
RR (GM’s discretion).
@@ 8
As Predict Weather I, except the area of the forecast is 3 miles per level of
the caster in radius.
@@ 9
As Waveshield, except this spell protects the ship from all inclement weather
(but not winds). Thus fogs, mists, rain, snow etc., will not affect the ship
(i.e., no rain will fall in the protected area, fog will remain outside the
protected area). Weather created as a result of magic may receive an RR (GM’s
discretion).
@@ 10
The area of effect for this spell is the water immediately surrounding the
boat or ship the caster is on. For as long as the caster concentrates, the
speed of the ship or boat can be increased by 50’ per round (approximately 3
miles per hour).
@@ 11
As Clear Fog, except for the area.
@@ 12
As Predict Weather I, except for the area.
@@ 13
As Call Fog, except for the area.
@@ 14
As Weathershield, except this spell protects the ship from all inclement
weather including storms, gales, and winds.
@@ 15
Caster may control the speed and direction of the wind. Caster can increase or
decrease wind speed by 1 mph times his level (e.g., assuming the current wind
speed was 20 mph, a 15th level caster could set the wind speed to any speed
between 5 mph and 35 mph). By directing the wind against missile attacks, he
can cause a -1 modification for each mph of wind. Note that the caster can
also control the direction of the flow of gases and/or clouds. The caster may
elect to control wind speed in a specified area or to center it upon himself
for a mobile radius of effect.
@@ 16
As Predict Weather V, except the caster has a 95% chance of predicting the
weather over a period equal to his level divided by five (round down) in days.
@@ 17
As Waveshield, except the caster may elect to control the waves in a specified
area or to center it upon himself for a mobile radius of effect.
@@ 19
As Command Winds, except the caster may indicate the weather conditions in the
area, modifying wind speeds by +/- 1 mph per level, and setting the intensity
of precipitation, fog, cloud cover, etc. Caster may call for shifts in the
patterns by concentrating, but any change will take at least d10 minutes. The
caster may elect to control the weather in a specified area or to center it
upon himself for a mobile radius of effect.
@@ 20
The caster can summon the forces of nature in a fierce sea storm with wind
speeds up to twice his level, waves of 20’-50’, and heavy rain. The storm can
be delayed up to 1 hour per level. After the storm is summoned, it will
dissipate normally. This spell may only be cast at sea (at least 1 mile away
from a coastline).
@@ 25
As Command Current I, except the speed of the ship or boat can be increased by
250’ per round (approximately 15 miles per hour).
@@ 30
As Command Weather, except for the area of effect and range.
@@ 50
As Command Storms, except for the area of effect and range.
